Container.Name: portkeeper
Container.Overview: Self-hosted companion for RomM that preserves game port releases and builds versioned packages from your own game files. No authentication: keep it on your LAN.

Config.Name: App data (small state)
Config.Description: Database, credentials, catalog, drafts and bounded state backups. Game payloads belong in Bulk storage.

Config.Name: Bulk storage
Config.Description: Archives, extracted games, caches, work and exact replay files. Existing installations must migrate before enabling this mount.

Config.Name: Bulk storage directory
Config.Description: Container path for bulky files; must match the Bulk storage mount. Review docs/STORAGE.md before migrating an existing install.

Config.Name: State backups to keep
Config.Description: Keep the last N complete managed metadata snapshots (1–20). Legacy migration copies are never pruned automatically.

Config.Name: Game inputs
Config.Description: Your own ROM library (read-only); never included in state backups

Config.Name: Library (RomM ports)
Config.Description: Published packages; outside appdata. Point at your existing RomM ports folder if different.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated addresses you open the web UI with, e.g. 192.168.1.20,tower,tower.local. Other addresses get 403 Unrecognized Host header.

Config.Name: Broker URL (optional)
Config.Description: Address of the build broker VM, e.g. https://broker-vm:8788. Pre-fills Settings → Automatic port setup; pairing with the one-time code printed by the broker is still done in the app. See docs/AUTOMATION.md.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (100 = users)
